notes.title: New update! Added Fish Exchange content!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110093/0eafc44ec9be54d3125074fc63da77654052df5e.png[/img]

[b]This content allows you to exchange fish! 🐟✨[/b]

Added Exchange system:
You can exchange certain grades of fish for common fish!
Exchange them for common fish and catch rarer fish through Merge content!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110093/d531d645a602c41c71085c7ad0001cb3b788645e.png[/img]

A new button has been created now.
Click on it, select the fish, and press the Exchange button to easily exchange them for a few regular fish.

When you exchange a [b]Green Common[/b] grade fish or a [b]Rare[/b] grade fish,
you can get a few common fish with the following probability.

Below are the fish exchange probabilities for each grade.

[Green Common]
Quantity: 1 regular Fish (25%) 
Quantity: 2 regular Fish (50%) 
Quantity: 3 regular Fish (25%) 

[Rare]
Quantity: 5 regular Fish (50%) 
Quantity: 6 regular Fish (30%) 
Quantity: 7 regular Fish (15%) 
Quantity: 8 regular Fish (5%)

notes.title: Item Store Update
notes.notes:
The Diamond Fish that was temporarily on sale has now been discontinued.

Instead, the Ruby Fish has temporarily taken its place.
The collection that was temporarily on sale in the Item Store will not be available again in the future.

[Item Store]
Remove [Limited] Diamond Fish
Add [Limited] Ruby Fish

O.o/ Good Luck!
